G1.decision: Use exactly one root DockSpace. Central documents are stable document windows docked into root document nodes; do not create a nested document DockSpace. Workbench preserves only ordered logical views, active document, state tokens, selection and bounded navigation history; the retired document host and split tree no longer own or persist geometry. KeepAliveOnly is not required because no inactive nested DockSpace exists.

evidence.claim: Document identity and history are semantic contracts independent of geometry.
The root DockSpace is the sole live human geometry owner and default layouts initialize without fighting saved user state.
Flat ordered logical surfaces preserve focus, active document, selection and navigation without geometry mutation.
Current writes contain semantic state only; bounded v9 decoding derives logical leaf order and discards obsolete geometry.

G2.decision: Functions Panel and Xref DB began as unreachable candidates with usable static-workspace providers and are activated through registry views. The unreachable competing Code Patcher header was retired after the registered Patches view gained complete create, apply, revert, remove, bounded code-cave discovery, diff, consequence review, readback and virtualized rendering parity against the shared backend.

evidence.claim: Functions Panel is compiled into a translation unit but not rendered.
Static immutable workspace xref query/filter is cancellable; live whole-process indexing is explicitly unsupported.

The reachable Patches surface owns the shared backend with bounded nonblocking snapshots, staged consequence review, verified apply/revert/remove, virtualized rows and executor-owned bounded code-cave discovery.

G2.center_alias_decision: Every center_view_t value maps to one canonical target view plus an exact selected subview. No alias may open a hub on an unrelated tab; aliases are migration-only and are removed after persisted state is upgraded.

G3.decision: Register only providers proven by source: text editing/file I/O, syntax tokenization, project tree/search, a real ConPTY terminal, and exact bounded PDB source debugging. Language navigation, LSP diagnostics, formatting, refactoring, configured build/test/run, and VCS remain disabled and unregistered until a real adapter is implemented.

evidence.claim: Real editor buffer, save, navigation, syntax and AI proposal review exist.
Real project tree, workspace search and file documents exist.
Exact PDB file-line resolution, persistent source breakpoints, stopped-address synchronization, bounded source loading and worker-owned target operations are implemented.

G4.decision: The Task Center is a read-only projection over existing executors. Cancel is visible only when the submitting owner registers a safe cancellation adapter for that exact handle. Runtime cancellation merely requests cancellation and the UI remains Requested until the owner reports terminal state. Security, license, ARC, integrity, heartbeat, driver guard, and shutdown work never opt in.

evidence.claim: The runtime exposes bounded snapshots and cooperative handle cancellation.
The common executor projects runtime IDs and cancellation.
Analysis owns a separate typed task identity and terminal state.

G5.decision: Initial Task Center history is bounded memory-only: at most 256 terminal successes for 24 hours and 512 failures/cancellations until acknowledged or seven days. Restart does not serialize callbacks, handles, arguments, request bodies, process bytes, tool payloads, credentials, license material, or chat content. Domain-owned existing persistence remains authoritative; the Task Center may reconstruct only redacted interrupted metadata explicitly published by that domain. Layout records contain geometry and stable view IDs only.

evidence.claim: Settings already separate protected secrets and workspace presentation state.
Workbench state is bounded, workspace-scoped and domain-owned.
Chat persistence is separately owned and must not be duplicated in task history.
Editor recovery is an existing separate content owner.
